description: Milestone-5 shared evaluation golden set. Run every question below through your own pipeline and score with the metrics from the RAG Evals lab (eval_metrics.py). This set is identical for every student because the M3 knowledge base and structured data are identical for every student -- do not edit these questions. You may add your own extra adversarial questions on top of this set as an optional bonus (see Build Guide, Step 5).
